dynamic_path_notes: gaussdb_probe.py:725-730 - for path,key in a literal 5-tuple => 5 fixed paths gaussdb.session.{total,active,waiting,idle_in_xact,lock_wait}; fully expanded above.
gaussdb_probe.py:1012 - f"replication.{k}" for k in ("state","sync_state","receiver_replay_location") => 3 fixed paths; bounded, expanded above.

gaussdb_probe.py:751/759/814/864/1094/1126/1155/1181/1190/1192/1326 - only obj_id is dynamic (sess-{pid}, tx-{pid}, sql-now-{unique_query_id}, sql-{unique_query_id}, idx-{indexrelname}, tbl-{relname}, wlm-{resource_pool}, wlm-user-{username}); the path strings are literals.

io_relay.py:165-184 - paths come from the P dict passed into _emit_chain(chain, tag, P); the literals live at io_relay.py:191-201 (write chain) and io_relay.py:202-212 (read chain). Each chain can emit 9 fixed paths; conditional presence: max_avg_us + worst_avg_event only if best_avg is not None; max_peak_us + worst_peak_event only if best_peak is not None; total_ms/present_count/expected_count always; missing only if a whitelist event is absent; fixed_period only if a fixed-period wait was detected. Full expansions listed above.
io_relay.py:274-277 - io.recent.window_min value is the recent_window_min argument; gaussdb_probe.py:791-794 passes literal 60, so it is always 60 minutes.
io_relay.py:232 - io.relay.event_count counts the by_event dict; no path loop.

os_probe.py:1284-1297 - for dev,sched in (samp.get('scheduler') or {}).items(): emits f"storage.io_scheduler.{dev}" for EVERY device key. The key set is produced by the SSH command cpu_mem_sample (os_probe.py:193-195: for d in /sys/block/*; case $n in sd*|nvme*|dm-*|ultrapath*) => NOT bounded by the code; it depends on the host's /sys/block. storage.io_scheduler (no suffix) is emitted only when dev startswith nvme|ultrapath.

os_probe.py:1535-1552 - for _p,_v in a literal 7-tuple => 7 fixed paths storage.ultrapath_vol_{node_ip,wwn,dev_lun_id,array,device,paths_available,paths_total}; each skipped when the value is None or empty; obj_id is the composite f"{host}|{nm}".

os_probe.py:1631-1639 - for path,val in a literal 7-tuple => 7 fixed paths storage.nvme_path.{array_sn,subsys_nqn,ctrl,state,traddr,host_traddr,trsvcid}; obj_id f"{sn}|{host}|{ctrl}"; only live endpoints.

os_probe.py:1603-1606 - for tgt,cnt in (s.get('live_paths_per_target') or {}).items(): path literal, obj_id f"target-{tgt}"; the target key set comes from `nvme list-subsys -o json` (os_probe.py:304-307), unbounded.

os_probe.py:1324-1332 - for dev,val in bio.items(): obj_id is the device key from the block_io_errors command (os_probe.py:216-220, ^(sd|nvme|dm-) from ls /sys/block, head -30) => bounded to 30 by the shell, not by Python.
os_probe.py:1362-1374 - for dev,txt in sh.items(): obj_id is the disk name from the smart_health command (lsblk -d ... head -12, os_probe.py:233-239) => up to 12.
os_probe.py:1391-1396 - for dev,cnt in (nv.get('aer') or {}).items(): obj_id is the PCI address from the nvme_ctrl_state command (os_probe.py:246-248), unbounded.
os_probe.py:1401-1414 - for p in rc.get('ports'): obj_id=dev parsed from /sys/class/infiniband/*/ports/* (os_probe.py:252-257), unbounded.
os_probe.py:1436-1451 - for n in rc.get('nics'): obj_id=dev from /sys/class/net/ matching ^(enp|eth) (os_probe.py:259-261), unbounded.

os_probe.py:1646-1658 - for dev,maj in dm.items(): obj_id is the ultrapath block device name from /sys/block/ultrapath* (os_probe.py:298-301), unbounded; only the derived major and consistency flag become paths.
os_probe.py:1814-1821 - _cluster_facts re-reads samp['scheduler'] across hosts; only two literal paths are emitted, no per-device path.

service/probes/__init__.py:107-116 - _make_fact(path, value, obj_id, obj_type, source, ts=None) returns {'path','value','obj_id','obj_type','source','ts'}; there is no path-formatting helper, so every path is passed whole except the fixed literal tuples listed above.
